about_the_game:
A New Era of Tycoon Games

Forget everything you know about tycoon games. Fashion Shop Simulator revolutionizes the genre by putting YOU directly inside your store. No more distant bird's-eye views - experience every customer interaction, every sale, and every moment of growth from a first-person perspective.

Your Journey to Fashion Empire

- Start Small - Begin with a humble clothing store, a few racks, and big dreams

- Hands-On Management - Physically grab clothes, hang them on racks, set prices, and serve customers yourself

- Grow Your Business - Order inventory through your in-game phone, track finances, and expand your product line

- Build Your Empire - Transform your small shop into a renowned fashion brand

Immersive First-Person Experience

- Realistic physics-based interactions - grab, throw, and arrange items naturally

- Serve customers directly at the register - process card payments and handle cash

- Use your smartphone to order stock, check finances, and manage your business

- Watch your shop come alive as customers browse, try on clothes, and make purchases

Key Features

- Revolutionary First-Person Tycoon Gameplay - Experience management like never before

- Physics-Based Interactions - Every item can be grabbed, moved, and placed

- Complete Business Simulation - Inventory, finances, and customers

- Day/Night Cycle - Manage your shop through opening hours with daily summaries

- Satisfying Progression - From street vendor to fashion mogul

Are You Ready?

The fashion industry awaits its next big name. Will you rise from a small shop owner to build a fashion empire? The journey starts with a single sale.

Welcome to Fashion Shop Simulator - Where every hanger tells a story.
